title: Multi-role missing-table triage and Production Governance readiness with no unreviewed DDL

phases.objective: Expose the current repository provider declaration as a claim, not proof of live Production capability; synchronize the exact 17-table/39-direct-privilege Governance contract and distinct DB principals in a read-only runbook.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Repository policy, documented provider claims, runbook direct table grant matrix, and Staging/Production isolation match source; Production remains live-unverified until the dedicated exact-SHA no-secret runtime probe passes.
steps: Read the checked-in Production provider capability declaration without connecting to the provider.
Compare all Governance matrix tables and operations with the exact documented runbook; fail on missing or wrong rows.
Prove the minimum Production Runtime and Runtime Persistence bootstrap grant surfaces remain distinct from the larger Staging runtime overlay.
Document exact Production runtime identity, independent database/principal privilege readiness and backup/Recovery Control Store gates before any provider or SQL mutation.
Preserve actual passed Production preflight through a schema-readiness failure and identify that the direct-grant matrix was not evaluated when table visibility blocked the probe.
Route any missing Runtime, Governance or Runtime Persistence required table through an independent exact-SHA full-object physical census, not the app-principal information_schema visibility count.

Require Recovery Kernel full-inspection findings to classify verified partial nonempty required-table absence as a non-executable finding, never as an automatically eligible grant or generic migration.
assertions: Provider configured support is distinct from live preflight, actual schema, credential readiness and privilege readback.
The canonical Governance privilege matrix is 17 tables / 39 direct grant operations, not a stale 7-table excerpt.
Staging runtime grants, audit_log access, credentials and 21 missing grants are never automatically promoted to Production.
No SQL, DB or provider connection, secret retrieval, workflow dispatch, privilege changes, Production restart or deployment is performed by the source parity check.
Two source-derived non-secret provider-claim parity booleans are governed CI configuration inputs; no temporary suppression or provider authority was granted.
If Governance Schema is incomplete, Production readiness stays blocked and cannot infer exact privilege failure or readiness from absence of grant readback.
A public Production status projection exposes only booleans for preflight/schema/privilege stages and bounded non-secret table counts, not schema object names or credentials.
The shared readiness runtime projection behavior is regression-tested on Staging and Production; Production actual schema changes remain explicitly excluded.

Zero required tables visible to a Governance app principal never proves physically empty database; role-empty rebuild requires a complete independent census of tables, views, triggers, routines and events.
Nonempty schemas with missing tables require role-bound registered migrations and independent approval; exact-grant repair is used only when physically present tables are privilege-invisible.
No new automatic Production SQL executor or schema creation is exposed; Source only generates fail-closed diagnostic next-action candidates.
Unknown or missing readiness booleans cannot be converted into deterministic recovery capabilities; zero-object rebuild is reserved for separately verified empty roles.
The exact Production provider documentation path is classified as repository governance by the canonical environment-impact authority; it is not exempted or broad-glob whitelisted.
